title: Dylan Page tries to lose the cops in GTA 6 with a new paint job
description: During his GTA 6 marathon, Dylan Page pulls into a mod shop with two stars, resprays his car in News Daddy blue and drives out past the police.
hook_text:
2 STARS ON HIM...
SO HE CHANGED COLOUR
first_comment: Respray to lose the cops or just outrun them? 👇
